name: Duke Leto Atreides
text: [When you play an [{Atreides}] unit:] You may exhaust this leader and defeat a friendly Spice token. If you do, give an Experience token to that unit.

backArt.src: Duke Leto Atreides - Duke of House Atreides (unit) (art).webp

backText:
[On Attack:] Give an Experience token to another friendly [{Atreides}] unit.
[When Defeated:] Deal 1 damage to each enemy ground unit.
subtitle: Duke of House Atreides
